objective: Lemmas M, H, G and AND-only by hand; flat states at every line of the frozen sphere set and AND on three non-octahedral hosts, computed.
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (by hand; checks pre-registered): a composite's function is the OR over its host's minimal unsatisfiable sets of the AND of their atoms' bits; every line of every Kasteleyn knot sphere is critical (every set S of lines touches at least |S| + 2 faces, then Hall), and growth keeps criticality, so AND is the only function over every host built from knot spheres and class-forced lattice tori. Checked on 16 spheres and three non-octahedral hosts.
title: AND for critical hosts
